trap.label: estar × be + place
trap.wrong: The keys stay on the table.
trap.right: The keys are on the table.
trap.why: Em português usamos "ficar" para localização; em inglês usa-se be + lugar.

fix.wrong: The keys is on the table.
fix.right: The keys are on the table.

fix.wrong: Tom stays in the office now.
fix.right: Tom is in the office now.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “The cat / on the sofa”. Use is.
rewrite.answer: The cat is on the sofa.

rewrite.prompt: Negue: “They are in the park.” (are not)
rewrite.answer: They are not in the park.
